sn22.56:1.5: yāvakīvañcāhaṃ bhikkhave, ime pañcupādānakkhandhe catuparivattaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nābbhaññāsiṃ, neva tāvāhaṃ bhikkhave sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddhoti paccaññāsiṃ.
sn22.56:1.6: yato ca khohaṃ bhikkhave, ime pañcupādānakkhandhe catuparivattaṃ yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, athāhaṃ bhikkhave, sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya
sn22.56:2.2: rūpaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, rūpasamudayaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, rūpanirodhaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, rūpanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ.
sn22.56:2.6: viññāṇaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, viññāṇasamudayaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, viññāṇanirodhaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, viññāṇanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ.
sn22.56:3.2: cattāro ca mahābhūtā catunnañca mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya rūpaṃ.
sn22.56:3.6: ayameva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo rūpanirodhagāminī paṭipadā, seyyathidaṃ:
sn22.56:3.7: sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākammanto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.
sn22.56:4.1: ye hi keci bhikkhave samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā evaṃ rūpaṃ abhiññāya evaṃ rūpasamudayaṃ abhiññāya evaṃ rūpanirodhaṃ abhiññāya evaṃ rūpanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ abhiññāya rūpassa nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipannā, te supaṭipannā,
sn22.56:4.2: ye supaṭipannā, te imasmiṃ dhammavinaye gādhanti.
sn22.56:5.1: ye ca kho keci bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā evaṃ rūpaṃ abhiññāya evaṃ rūpa samudayaṃ abhiññāya evaṃ rūpa nirodhaṃ abhiññāya evaṃ rūpanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ abhiññāya, rūpassa nibbidā virāgā nirodhā anupādā vimuttā te suvimuttā.
sn22.56:5.3: ye kevalino, vaṭṭaṃ tesaṃ natthi paññāpanāya.
sn22.56:6.3: cakkhusamphassajā vedanā, sotasamphassajā vedanā, ghānasamphassajā vedanā, jivhāsamphassajā vedanā, kāyasamphassajā vedanā, manosamphassajā vedanā.
sn22.56:6.7: ayameva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo vedanānirodhagāminī paṭipadā, seyyathidaṃ:
sn22.56:7.1: ye hi keci bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā evaṃ vedanaṃ abhiññāya evaṃ vedanāsamudayaṃ abhiññāya evaṃ vedanānirodhaṃ abhiññāya evaṃ vedanānirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ abhiññāya vedanāya nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipannā, te supaṭipannā.
sn22.56:7.2: ye supaṭipannā, te imasmiṃ dhammavinaye gādhanti.
sn22.56:8.1: ye ca kho keci bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā evaṃ vedanaṃ abhiññāya evaṃ vedanāsamudayaṃ abhiññāya evaṃ vedanānirodhaṃ abhiññāya evaṃ vedanānirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ abhiññāya vedanāya nibbidā virāgā nirodhā anupādā vimuttā, te suvimuttā, ye suvimuttā, te kevalino, ye kevalino,
sn22.56:9.3: rūpasaññā, saddasaññā, gandhasaññā, rasasaññā, phoṭṭhabbasaññā, dhammasaññā.
sn22.56:9.7: ayameva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo saññānirodhagāminī paṭipadā: seyyathidaṃ:
sn22.56:9.8: sammādiṭṭhi …pe… sammāsamādhi. yehi keci bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā evaṃ saññaṃ abhiññāya …pe…
sn22.56:10.3: rūpasañcetanā, saddasañcetanā, gandhasañcetanā, rasasañcetanā, phoṭṭhabbasañcetanā, dhammasañcetanā.
sn22.56:10.7: ayameva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo saṅkhāranirodhagāminī paṭipadā: seyyathidaṃ:
sn22.56:11.1: ye hi keci bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā evaṃ saṅkhāre abhiññāya …pe…
sn22.56:13.3: cakkhuviññāṇaṃ, sotaviññāṇaṃ, ghānaviññāṇaṃ, jivhāviññāṇaṃ, kāyaviññāṇaṃ, manoviññāṇaṃ.
sn22.56:13.7: ayameva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo viññāṇanirodhagāminī paṭipadā: seyyathidaṃ:
sn22.56:14.1: ye hi keci bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā evaṃ viññāṇaṃ abhiññāya, evaṃ viññāṇasamudayaṃ abhiññāya, evaṃ viññāṇanirodhaṃ abhiññāya, evaṃ viññāṇanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ abhiññāya viññāṇassa nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipannā, te supaṭipannā.
sn22.56:14.2: ye supaṭipannā te imasmiṃ dhammavinaye gādhanti.
sn22.56:15.1: ye ca kho keci bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā evaṃ viññāṇaṃ abhiññāya, evaṃ viññāṇasamudayaṃ abhiññāya, evaṃ viññāṇanirodhaṃ abhiññāya, evaṃ viññāṇanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ abhiññāya viññāṇassa nibbidā virāgā nirodhā anupādā vimuttā, te suvimuttā.
sn22.56:15.3: ye kevalino vaṭṭaṃ tesaṃ natthi paññāpanāyāti.
